title: MATERIAL normal method before strength without refraction transform
mode: P3 local source-order parser/writer slice with generated ASCII/Binary controls
scope: Recognize a repeated group 271 as the normal-map method when bump tiling was already bound, no refraction transform was present, and group 465 follows immediately.
Retain the bump tiling value, require the complete distinguishing normal-map tuple, and reject a candidate with missing strength or incomplete fields.
Keep raw-body role classification consistent with typed parsing and verify ASCII/Binary source and output, readback, atomic destination refusal, and corrected retry.

peer.physicalSequence: The NormalOnly MATERIAL body contains bump tiling 271=1, normal method 271=7, strength 465=0.5, then normal-map groups 42/72/3/73/74/75, with no group-147 refraction matrix.
peer.limitation: The complete peer drawing fails earlier on a ByBlock material with an unrelated duplicate group 73 and an unmarked second blend. That failure is not attributed to NormalOnly and the drawing is not treated as semantic-conformance evidence.

evidence.sourceCreation: The owning test locally authors the isolated target field sequence and malformed controls at runtime. Test-generated drawings are removed; no peer or test drawing is committed.

implementation.summary: The MATERIAL parser accepts the repeated pre-strength group 271 only under the witnessed boundary conditions and requires group 465 immediately after the candidate. The raw-body writer classifier identifies the same occurrence only in the top-level AcDbMaterial body, outside APPDATA/XDATA and without a refraction matrix. Inferred boundaries require a complete normal-map tuple.
behaviorChanges: The witnessed normal-map field order imports while retaining bump tiling and normal method as separate typed roles.
ASCII and Binary outputs preserve the normal method and strength roles and reimport with the edited values.
Conflicting raw/typed normal-method edits refuse without replacing the destination; restoring the source allows same-adapter retry.
Missing strength and incomplete normal tuples are refused; a corrected input imports through the same adapter.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 1/1 in 7.16 seconds; covers ASCII/Binary input and output, physical roles, typed edits, readback, malformed refusal, rollback and retry.

limitations: This qualifies the witnessed source order and local serializer/readback behavior only; it does not prove the full ezdxf drawing is conformant or establish native renderer meaning.
The new private DRW_Material parser-state flag changes class layout; ABI qualification remains in P8.
Other MATERIAL source profiles, producer conformance, native rendering, version semantics and complete-document closure remain open.
